name: Theology and Mission
credential: Bachelor's degree in Theology and Mission
about: Bible, theology, church history and practical ministry, with a chosen direction in congregational leadership, evangelism and apologetics, or biblical studies; offered in parallel Estonian, English and Russian curricula.

name: International Business Administration
about: Business fundamentals, then a specialisation in finance and accounting or in marketing and communication, with two internships and a mobility window; a double degree with Lancaster University Management School is possible.

name: Impactful Entrepreneurship
about: Learn entrepreneurship by building your own business idea through a simulation that follows a company from first concept to growth or exit, guided by entrepreneurs and mentors, with two internships.

name: Product and Technology Management
about: Combines product management, technology and business to take digital products from user need to launch, through projects, simulations and internships; developed with the coding school //kood.

name: Classical Music Performance
about: Classical and contemporary performance on keyboard, string, wind, brass and percussion instruments, voice or choral conducting, with individual lessons, chamber music, orchestral study and an opera staged each year.

name: Composition and Multimedia
about: Classical composition alongside music technology and multimedia: electroacoustic music, live electronics, video and installation art, with workshops, projects and the yearly COMMUTE Festival.

name: Sound Engineering and Music Production
about: A fine arts programme in music production, songwriting and professional recording, covering studio and live recording of classical and non-classical music with artistic and technical training.

name: Jazz Music
about: Jazz and improvisation studied in ensembles, with individual development at the centre and international courses most years; the school belongs to the International Association of Schools of Jazz.

name: Veterinary Medicine
about: Six-year integrated bachelor's and master's in veterinary medicine, from animal anatomy and biology through pre-clinical and clinical study, with practical training in the university's own Animal Clinic.

name: Creativity and Business Innovation
about: Prepares entrepreneurs, product or service managers and business executives to build and run innovative ventures, with modules in business management, start-ups, research methods and an internship.

name: Creativity and Business Innovations (Joint Programme)
about: The same business-innovation degree, studied across Tallinn, Vilnius University of Applied Sciences in Lithuania and the Polytechnic Institute of Porto in Portugal; the page lists the next admission as autumn 2027.

name: Artificial Intelligence Driven Software Technologies and Entrepreneurship
about: Goes beyond classical computer science: you manage AI-assisted software development, build market-ready platforms in agile sprints and learn privacy by design, with modules in data analysis, entrepreneurship and maths.

name: Game Design and Development
about: Skills to develop mobile and PC games and start a games company; you specialise in game graphics or software development, with game jams and lectures from industry professionals.

name: Integrated Engineering
about: Combines ICT with mechanical and electrical engineering; you study programming, computer-aided design, robotics and digital manufacturing, with a semester abroad possible through Erasmus+.

name: Cyber Security Engineering
about: Design, build and maintain secure IT systems, mixing hands-on work with theory; deep prior maths, programming or IT knowledge is helpful but not essential.

name: International Business Administration
about: Builds knowledge and skills for an international business career, taught in English at the School of Business and Governance, with specialisations chosen within the degree.

name: Law
about: Classical legal principles alongside technology law, cyber security and data protection law, EU and international law, with moot court and a legal internship.

name: Audiovisual Media
about: Storytelling for film and television, from documentary and fiction to music videos. You choose a creative module (writing, directing, producing) or a technical one (camera, sound, editing, colour) and finish with a practical film.

name: Crossmedia
about: Stories that move between platforms, from film to television to live performance, combining audiovisual content with print, events, apps, games and social media, plus the business side of media.

name: Liberal Arts in Humanities
about: A three-year humanities degree that starts from shared foundations and moves to your own path through specialist modules, electives, project work and an internship across culture, history, language and society.

name: Liberal Arts in Social Sciences
about: An interdisciplinary base across sociology, political science, international relations, economics, law and psychology, with research methods, an internship and a project; you shape your own direction through electives.

name: Politics and Governance
about: How political systems, institutions and policy work, with options in comparative politics, public administration, global governance, European politics and international relations.

name: Law
about: European and international law at the core, taught through case analysis, legal writing, group work, mock trials and moot court; no earlier legal study is needed.

name: Business Administration
about: Covers economics, finance, marketing and management alongside technical skills, with an entrepreneurial approach and a startup community. Taught in Tartu at the Delta Centre.

name: Science and Technology
about: A broad base in natural and technological sciences; you choose genetics and biotechnology, bioengineering and robotics, or chemistry and materials science in the second year.

name: Medicine
about: Integrated bachelor's and master's studies in English at Tartu University Hospital, working with patients; you also learn Estonian to work in local hospitals.

name: Business Process Management
about: Managerial training for fast-changing workplaces: organisational management, leadership, finance and business process management, with creative project methods and real company challenges; qualification Enterprise Manager.

name: Finance Management Information Systems
about: FinTech joining software engineering and financial management, taught jointly with Riga Technical University; graduates get the qualification Programming Engineer.

name: International Finance
about: Double-degree programme with SBS Swiss Business School on international business and finance, for careers in banking, finance, entrepreneurship or marketing; qualification Financier.

name: Biosystems Machinery and Technologies
about: Engineering design, mechatronics and programming joined with the basics of biosystems in agriculture, wood processing, food production and animal husbandry, including CNC manufacturing technology.

name: Information Technologies for Sustainable Development
about: Software design with attention to the sustainability of software and hardware, in laboratories for development and quality assurance, with a year of internship at IT companies; qualification Programming Engineer.

name: Sociology of Organizations and Public Administration
about: Contemporary society and its organisations studied with e-learning, guest-lecture weeks, field trips and discussions, in a student-centred programme with September and February entry.

name: Veterinary Medicine
about: Six-year English-taught programme (360 ECTS) on animal health, disease diagnosis and treatment, zoonoses and food hygiene, following a One Medicine - One Health concept; the qualification is Veterinarian.

name: Computer Science
about: Programming, algorithms, databases, web technologies and mathematics, with a 4.5-month internship in an IT organisation after two years and a software-engineering specialisation; carries the Euro-Inf label.

name: Biotechnology and Bioengineering
about: A joint English-taught degree of the University of Latvia and Riga Technical University, linking biology, chemistry and engineering with practical work; a route into biotechnology and bioengineering master's study.

name: Business Administration
about: Prepares you to found and run a business or work in public, private and international organisations, with a specialisation in International Business, plus teamwork, presentation and analytical skills.

name: Cultural and Social Anthropology
credential: Bachelor of Social Sciences in Anthropology
about: Human social and cultural diversity studied through migration, global mobility and intercultural contact, taught by the Faculty of Economics and Social Sciences in English.

name: English, European Languages and Business Studies
about: Three tracks, English Language, English-Scandinavian Languages, and European Languages and Business Studies, combining English linguistics and culture with a second European language and, in one track, business.

name: East-West Intercultural Studies
about: The English-taught strand of the Asian and Intercultural Studies degree: Eastern and Western civilisations compared, with cultural understanding and language learning for work in public bodies, NGOs and business.

name: Industrial Engineering and Management
about: Engineering, management and natural sciences in one interdisciplinary programme leading to the qualification Industrial Management Engineer.

name: International Economics and Commercial Diplomacy
credential: Bachelor of Social Sciences in Economics
about: International economics and business together with law, politics and foreign languages; builds teamwork and presentation skills and macro- and microeconomic analysis.

name: Philology (French, German or Russian)
about: Language, literature and culture studied in English through a French, German or Russian sub-programme, with a second language (Spanish, Italian, Czech or Polish in some strands).

name: Optometry
credential: Bachelor of Health Sciences in Optometry
about: Vision science drawn from physics, maths, biology, chemistry and psychology; full qualification as an optometrist needs a master's degree, five years in total.

name: Medicine
about: Six-year English-taught medical degree, 360 ECTS, built on Scandinavian teaching practice with small groups and electives in languages, psychology, economics and law.

name: Dentistry
about: Five-year English-taught dentistry degree, 300 ECTS, training you to practise general dentistry independently: diagnosis, treatment planning and restoring tooth shape, function and appearance.

name: Medicine
about: Six-year English-taught MD (360 ECTS) built around patient-centred problems and group work, with work with patients from the third year and simulation training at the university's simulation centre.

name: Dentistry
about: Five-year English-taught dentistry degree (300 ECTS): diagnosis, restorative treatment, implants and dental public health, practised first on simulation models and then in clinic.

name: International Business and Start-up Entrepreneurship
about: A three-year business bachelor on international business and start-up economics, with project semesters, simulations, placements and pitching to investors with the university's business incubator.

name: Civil Engineering
about: Design and construction of buildings, bridges and infrastructure, with digital design tools and practical skills; a three-year academic bachelor taught in English on RTU's Riga campus.

name: Engineering Technology, Mechanics and Mechanical Engineering
about: Mechanics and mechanical engineering fundamentals with practical problem-solving and modern digital tools, preparing you to design, analyse and improve mechanical systems.

name: Medical Engineering and Physics
about: Physics and medicine joined, run with Rīga Stradiņš University; tracks include nanomedicine, medical electronics, biomechanics and assistive technologies. 4.5 years.

name: Environmental Engineering
about: Technical solutions for a zero-pollution, climate-neutral future across environmental engineering, energy and sustainability; a three-year academic bachelor.

name: Materials Engineering
about: Materials science combined with AI, digital technologies and entrepreneurship, aimed at sustainable materials and high-value technologies; three years.

name: Computer Systems
about: The whole software engineering lifecycle, from systems analysis and project management to development and testing, with programming languages, AI fundamentals and databases.

name: Telecommunication Technologies and Data Transmission Engineering
about: Communication systems and large data networks: signal transmission and reception, information security, network interconnection and the design of communication systems.

name: Smart Electronic Systems
about: Hands-on electronics engineering: the hardware inside devices from smartphones to satellites; a four-year professional bachelor with an electronics engineer qualification.

name: Finance Management Information Systems
about: FinTech where finance meets IT: banking, digital payments and secure systems, taught jointly with the University of Latvia, with a joint diploma and Programming Engineer qualification.

name: Entrepreneurship and Management
about: Social-science foundations in entrepreneurship and management with research skills, qualifying you for master's study; taught in English by the Faculty of Engineering Economics and Management.

name: Business Administration
about: Riga Business School management degree made with BI Norwegian Business School and the University at Buffalo, with focuses on AI and data, marketing, finance and entrepreneurship.

name: Computer Science
about: Building applications, AI and digital systems at RTU's Liepāja Academy, with practice-led teamwork on real company problems and links to the local tech hub.

name: Marine Engineering (Maritime Transport)
about: Marine engineering at the RTU Latvian Maritime Academy leading to the professional qualification Ship's Engineer; 4.3 years (278 ECTS).

name: Navigation (Maritime Transport)
about: Navigation at the RTU Latvian Maritime Academy leading to the professional qualification Navigator; 4.3 years (278 ECTS).

name: Economics and Business
credential: BSc (Bachelor of Social Sciences in Economics)
about: A three-year, 195 ECTS degree taught entirely in English, with two paid summer internships and a choice of specialisation in the last year: economics, finance, entrepreneurship, data and AI, retail or international politics.

name: Computer Science
credential: BSc Natural Sciences in Computer Science
about: Computer science foundations with AI built into the teaching, a software-engineering specialisation, and a choice of English or Latvian; also available part-time and blended.

name: Computer Science: AI Double Degree
credential: TSI BSc + UWE Bristol BSc (Hons) double degree
about: Four-year double degree with UWE Bristol in the UK, taught in English, with an artificial intelligence specialisation for building and evaluating AI-based software solutions.

name: Computer Engineering and Electronics
about: Industrial electronics, embedded systems, computer networks and telecommunications, with specialisations in embedded electronics, industrial electronics or telecommunication systems and computer networks.

name: Robotics
about: Automation and robotics from industrial robots to autonomous systems, including robot programming, control and integration on advanced robotic platforms.

name: Transport and Logistics
about: Transport systems, smart logistics and business analytics for running data-driven international supply chains, with specialisations in sustainable transport or smart logistics; qualification Logistics Manager.

name: Aviation Engineering
about: Aerodynamics, propulsion, avionics, maintenance and airworthiness management, with hands-on training and industry experience; a choice of mechanics or avionics specialisation.

name: Business and Management
about: Management, economics, marketing, finance and entrepreneurship, building analytical and leadership skills for companies and start-ups, with an artificial intelligence specialisation.

name: Computer Systems
about: Software engineering, computer architecture, system analysis and databases, built on ACM curriculum standards, with internships at IT companies; leads to the qualification Software Engineer.

name: Business Administration
about: Hands-on business degree with about 60% practical study, business-plan work and a business incubator; leads to the qualification Company Manager.

name: Business Logistics Management
about: Logistics and supply-chain management taught for newcomers and professionals alike, awarded as a professional bachelor's in business administration with the qualification Company Manager.

name: International Communication Management
about: International project management, integrated marketing communication, crisis communication, international law and public speaking, with internships at institutions such as the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

name: Tourism and Hospitality Management
about: Management of tourism and hospitality services with internships at Latvian and foreign companies; the programme holds UNWTO TedQual accreditation and leads to the qualification Tourism Services Manager.

name: Computer Science
about: Computer basics, networks, standalone and network programming, and deeper subjects such as calculus, data structures and differential equations, with traineeships at research institutes and IT firms.

name: Business Administration
about: Management, finance, public relations and customer psychology taught in English so you can start a business or take a managerial role.

name: Start-Up Management
about: Learning by doing in technology entrepreneurship: you start setting up your own company in the first year with mentors, leading to a professional bachelor's in business administration and the qualification Enterprise Manager.

name: Physiotherapy
about: Anatomy, physiotherapy and medicine with 920 hours of clinical training in hospitals and spas (180 ECTS). The page says the English version runs only in Maribor, full-time and fee-paying.

name: Nursing
about: Three-year nursing degree (180 ECTS) with compulsory clinical training at home and abroad, taught in Maribor and Murska Sobota; the English version is fee-paying.

name: Social Gerontology
about: Ageing and the needs of older adults from social, psychological and societal angles, in six semesters (180 ECTS); practical training and vaccination certificate are part of enrolment.

name: Business Management
about: Professional programme (180 ECTS) joining strategy, finance, law, information systems, quality and leadership, with two six-week practical placements and an optional family-business module.

name: Archives Management
about: Archival science (180 ECTS): creating, classifying, preserving and protecting documents, including electronic records and digital archives.

name: Humanities
about: Humanities studies (180 ECTS) on ideas, values, history, culture and art, applied to ethics, politics, intercultural relations and technology; hybrid delivery from Ljubljana.

name: Web and Information Technologies
about: Programming, web and mobile development, data, information security and web analytics in six semesters (180 ECTS); delivered remotely with mostly online exams.

name: Entrepreneurship
about: Part-time professional degree (180 ECTS) in entrepreneurship, marketing and management, with real company projects, two internship blocks and a business plan; lectures are on weekday afternoons and Saturday mornings.

name: University Degree Programme in Business and Economics
about: A three-year business and economics degree (180 ECTS) at the School of Economics and Business; the English version adds second-year specialisations in International Business, Marketing or Tourism.

name: Economic and Business Studies
about: English-taught specialisation of the Economic and Business Sciences degree: economics, international business, marketing and management, then a choice of business management, health-care management or supply chains in year two.

name: Contemporary Tourism Practices
about: A professional tourism degree (180 ECTS) taught in English in Ljubljana: tourism products, entrepreneurship, marketing, languages and a 560-hour internship.

name: Crisis Management
about: A professional degree (180 ECTS) at the Faculty of Organizational Sciences in Kranj: crisis management, psychology and law in crises, information support and communication.

name: Physics and Astrophysics
about: Research-oriented physics degree (180 ECTS) taught in Ajdovščina: core mathematics and physics with lab methods in year one, then astrophysics and solid-state physics, with work in the university's research labs.

name: Anthropology
about: Double-discipline degree (180 ECTS) in the Faculty of Humanities: fieldwork, participant observation and research methods for understanding societies and cultures, from Slovenia and the Mediterranean to the Americas.

name: Cultural Heritage
about: Double-discipline degree (180 ECTS) drawing on archaeology, art history, ethnology, architecture and history, with practical and field work on tangible and intangible heritage.

name: Management
about: Theory-led degree (180 ECTS, 32 courses) combining business and economics at the Faculty of Management in Koper, delivered in English and aimed at postgraduate study or management roles.

name: Bioinformatics
about: Biology, chemistry, physics and genetics combined with mathematics and computer science, for analysing data and modelling biological systems. Three years (180 ECTS) in Koper and Izola.

name: Computer Science
about: Programming languages, development tools and software-building methods, with analytical thinking for ICT systems. Three years (180 ECTS) in Koper.

name: Mathematics
about: Analysis, algebra, discrete mathematics and numerical computation in year one, then electives in theoretical and applied mathematics. Three years (180 ECTS) in Koper.

name: Mathematics and Computer Science
about: Mathematical foundations (analysis, algebra) combined with computer science, leading into data science, machine learning and information security. Three years (180 ECTS) in Koper.

name: Wood Innovation for Sustainability
credential: Bachelor of Applied Science in Wood Engineering
about: Professional degree (180 ECTS) joining natural science and engineering with wood properties, manufacturing and circular bioeconomy, plus digitalisation, data analytics and AI in the wood sector.

name: Tourism Destination Management
about: Professional programme training managers of tourism organisations and complex tourism processes, taught by the Faculty of Tourism Studies Turistica in Ljubljana as part-time study.

name: Tourism Enterprise Management
about: Tourism markets, marketing, economics, languages and the business and organisation of tourism firms; taught in English in Portorož by the Faculty of Tourism Studies Turistica.
